title: Create a character first, then build a storyboard using that same character…
content: Create a character first, then build a storyboard using that same character, then animate the storyboard in Seedance 2.0.
tips: Create a character first, then build a storyboard using that same character, then animate the storyboard in Seedance 2.0.

fr.content: Créez d'abord un personnage, puis construisez un storyboard en utilisant ce même personnage, puis animez le storyboard dans Seedance 2.0.

ja.content:
